description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): seat your other bots in one call. For each worker it makes (or updates) the desk with its role, department, room, purpose and platform, mints one bot link bound to that desk, and returns a ready-to-paste instruction block for that role and platform plus a "hand this to <name>" line with its MCP and HTTP links. role_id is a library role id (see /roles.html, e.g. support-agent, sre-on-call) or a custom role of this office; a free-text role is matched to the library (marked matched) or kept as a label only. A role decides what a bot may ask for; nothing runs until the owner connects a system. Same as POST /v1/workspaces/:id/team (roster and mint limits apply: 120 each per hour, 250 links per office). Tokens are shown once. Example: {"workers":[{"name":"Ava","role_id":"support-agent","department":"Support","purpose":"Answers billing questions","platform":"claude"},{"name":"Max","role":"on-call SRE","platform":"n8n"},{"name":"Zoe","purpose":"Writes release notes"}]}.

label.description: A label for every link made here.

workers.description: One entry per bot to seat.

label.description: A note on the link for the owner's list.

platform.description: What runs it (claude, chatgpt, grok, gemini, copilot, n8n, make, zapier, api …): shapes the instruction block.

purpose.description: One line on what the bot does.

role.description: Free-text role when you have no id ("billing support", "on-call SRE"): matched to the library.

role_id.description: A library role id or custom:<id> of this office.

room.description: A room id of the office's kit (optional; the role picks one).
